companyFieldUpdates.description: Environmental 360 Solutions is a North American waste-management and environmental-infrastructure platform serving municipal, commercial and industrial customers. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Aurora, Ontario, E360S provides collection, transfer, recycling, special and liquid waste, emergency response and industrial-cleaning services. Current company materials report more than 800,000 customers across Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan and Michigan. BlackRock Global Infrastructure Fund IV closed a majority acquisition on February 16, 2023. Founder Donato Ardellini retained a significant stake and Canadian Business Growth Fund retained and increased its minority position; exact percentages are not publicly disclosed. OPTrust and Oaktree exited at the 2023 closing. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a separate GIP ownership period. E360S entered the United States through a Michigan acquisition announced in July 2026, and no later platform sale or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
